svg.title: British Mandate for Palestine, 1922
svg.desc: GCSE History cartographic map showing unified Mandatory Palestine under the 1922 League of Nations Mandate, the 1922 Transjordan boundary along the Jordan River, Dead Sea and Wadi Arava, neighbouring territories (French Mandate Syria and Lebanon, Transjordan, Egypt/Sinai), key towns, and conservative population figures for 1922 and 1946.

g.text: Jordan River – Dead Sea – Wadi Arava
excluded east of this line, Sept 1922)
